newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed on Thursday in featureles trade, dealers said.
They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. weekly jobless claims and August durable goods data.
Weekly jobless claims for the week ended September 21 is forecast to be around 328,000 compared with 329,000 reported in the previous week.
August durable goods figures is expected to show a decline of 0.1 percent against July's 1.7 percent.
"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on some position adjustments," a local dealer said.
"All eyes are on tonight's weekly jobless claims and durable goods figures. But I don't think there will be much impact unless the numbers are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Thursday/Friday and weekend were unchanged from Wednesday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.
Week-fixed rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from Wednesday's 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16, six-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 and twelve-months unchanged at 6 5-7/8 percent.
